title: College Football
description:
Texas Tech at Colorado
The Colorado Buffaloes host the No. 12 Texas Tech Red Raiders at Folsom Field in Boulder. The Buffaloes lost 23-13 to the Bears and rely on quarterback Julian Lewis, while the Red Raiders beat the Bearkats, 49-14, paced by quarterback Will Hammond.

title: College Football
description:
Cincinnati at Arizona
The Cincinnati Bearcats face the Arizona Wildcats in Week 5 of the NCAAF in a Big 12 game. The Bearcats hold a perfect record and won against Kansas State Wildcats, 31-26, in Week 4. Arizona defeated Washington State, 34-24, in their previous game.
